rows.label: the app is up, with a 4 × 3 m room and nothing in it
F12 — one room screen: no canned shapes in either door, + Box in both
F1 — the editor opens, and asks for the first corner
F1 — pointing right and clicking lays the first wall down
F1 — …and its length is TYPED
F1 — the angle field carries 90, to be overtyped
F1 — a change of direction is 90° by default
F1 — …unless you type another angle: the third wall takes the 45
F1 — Undo takes back ONE segment, not the wall
F1 — the outline becomes the room, and the app knows which walls were DRAWN
F2 — six 600 mm cabinets leave a gap too small for a seventh
F2 — …so the app offers the share-out, at the moment the last one goes in
F2 — it is a BAR at the gap, not a modal in the middle of the screen
rows.detail:
{"gap":"260","each":"643","text":"260 mm left over
·
Share it out equally · 643 mm each
…or 7 cabinets at 551 mm"}

rows.label: F2 — every cabinet is one width, wall to wall, less the two scribes
F2 — and ONE Ctrl+Z takes the whole run back
F3 — a height that will not fit is refused, with the ROOM’s figure in it
rows.detail: 01: the room is 2500 mm and this stands 100 mm off the floor — 2600 mm will not fit. 2400 mm is what is left.

rows.label: F3 — the owner’s own case: a top box with no headroom is BLOCKED
rows.detail: The room is 2300 mm and this stands 2250 mm off the floor — there is only 50 mm left, and a top box needs 200.

rows.label: F4 — a low unit beside a tall one grows the panel, stamped as the app’s own
F4 — …and the app says what it did, and how to undo it
rows.detail: T01: the app added a finishing end panel where this meets the cabinet beside it — right-click it and Remove if you do not want it.

rows.label: F5 — the end panel under the slope STOPS at it, and states its angle
F7 — the cut door lost hinges, and the record says how many
F6 — a shaker leaf under the slope keeps its recess, and the recess follows the cut
F9 — on a WARDROBE, the cargo pull-out and the waste bins are ABSENT
F9 — …and on a KITCHEN cabinet they are there, where they make sense
F10 — neither "Add doors" nor "Show all dimensions" is in the menu
F13 — 2150, and the two places that carry it agree
F14 — the rig ships at 0.75 of its base, and a pillar at 11 × 0.75 = 8.25
